title: Successor cycle restrictions commute with both projections
statement: Let $C$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $U,V$ finite decreasing filtered cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration], and $t:U\to V$ filtered. Fix $r\ge1$, $a=(p,q)$, representative differential data $D_U,D_V$ at $r$ and $D_U\prime,D_V\prime$ at $r+1$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], and page chain maps $m_0,m_1$ satisfying the universal four-square property [lem-sp-filtered-quotient-page-maps] at their respective pages. Let $f_U:Z_{r+1}^{p,p+q}(U)\to\operatorname{cycles}(D_U.\mathrm{page})^a$ and $f_V$ of the analogous type satisfy $f_X\iota_{\mathrm{cycles}}=\operatorname{ofLE}(Z_{r+1}\le Z_r)\pi_r$ for $X=U,V$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-normalized-homology]. There exists $k:Z_{r+1}^{p,p+q}(U)\to Z_{r+1}^{p,p+q}(V)$ such that $k f_V=f_U\operatorname{cyclesMap}(m_0)^a$ and $\pi^U_{r+1}m_1^a=k\pi^V_{r+1}$, with cycles and quotient projections as in [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients].

source.place: Tag 012K, Lemmas 12.24.2 and 12.24.4; parent proof step 3, the successor-cycle equation before taking homology; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Choose step restrictions s from the preservation property of t. Cancel the target step inclusion to obtain the square between consecutive steps, and use cokernel.map to construct a single graded map g with its quotient projection equation. Apply filteredQuotient_map_restrictions at r and r+1, using filteredComplex_boundaries_le_cycles for its containment hypothesis, to obtain current and successor cycle restrictions and quotient maps.

Apply the universal property hypotheses hm0 and hm1 to these restriction squares, identifying the constructed quotient maps with the components of m0 and m1. Cancel the target graded cycle inclusion and use Subobject.ofLE_arrow to show that the successor restriction commutes with inclusion into current cycles. Postcompose the proposed fU/fV square with the monic target page cycle inclusion. Rewrite hfU, hfV, the current quotient projection square, and HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i; associativity and the cycle inclusion square prove the equality. Cancel the page cycle inclusion.

The successor quotient projection square supplied by filteredQuotient_map_restrictions, after replacing its quotient map by m1 via hm1, is exactly the second asserted equation. Pair the two equations with the successor cycle restriction witness.

proof_origin.note: P4: reuse the existing filteredQuotient_map_restrictions construction at both pages; the remaining argument is monic cancellation, the given universal page-map properties, and associativity.

theorem filteredQuotient_successor_cycle_maps
    (U V : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun W : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ↦ W.filtration.IsFinite))
    (t : U ⟶ V) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (DU : FilteredComplexPageDifferential U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration r)
    (DV : FilteredComplexPageDifferential V.obj.obj V.obj.filtration r)
    (DU' : FilteredComplexPageDifferential U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration (r + 1))
    (DV' : FilteredComplexPageDifferential V.obj.obj V.obj.filtration (r + 1))
    (m0 : DU.page ⟶ DV.page) (m1 : DU'.page ⟶ DV'.page)
    (hm0 : FilteredQuotientPageMapProperty U V t r DU DV m0)
    (hm1 : FilteredQuotientPageMapProperty U V t (r + 1) DU' DV' m1)
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (fU : (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶
      DU.page.cycles pq)
    (fV : (V.obj.filtration.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶
      DV.page.cycles pq)
    (hfU : fU ≫ DU.page.iCycles pq = Subobject.ofLE _ _
      (filteredComplex_cycles_successor_le U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration r pq) ≫
        filteredComplexPageπ U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration r pq)
    (hfV : fV ≫ DV.page.iCycles pq = Subobject.ofLE _ _
      (filteredComplex_cycles_successor_le V.obj.obj V.obj.filtration r pq) ≫
        filteredComplexPageπ V.obj.obj V.obj.filtration r pq) :
    ∃ k : (U.obj.filtration.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶
        (V.obj.filtration.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C),
      k ≫ fV = fU ≫ HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap m0 pq ∧
      filteredComplexPageπ U.obj.obj U.obj.filtration (r + 1) pq ≫ m1.f pq =
        k ≫ filteredComplexPageπ V.obj.obj V.obj.filtration (r + 1) pq
